Public Health Wales brand colours

Source: R/colours.R
phw_colours.Rd

A named character vector of every colour in the PHW identity, as used by its Communicable Disease Surveillance Centre (CDSC). Each colour and its role is listed in system.file("brand", "palette.csv", package = "phwstyle").

Usage

phw_colours

Format

A named character vector of hex colours.

Details

  • navy, teal, orange, pink are the four chart colours PHW reports use today, in that order.

  • blue_534 and gold_465 are the official NHS Wales logo colours (Pantone 534 and 465).

  • blue, green, magenta come from the phw.nhs.wales website.

  • Greys and text are the NHS digital front-end neutrals used on the site.

  • mint and green_bright are two of the six strategic priority colours in PHW's Long-Term Strategy 2023 to 2035.

Examples

phw_colours["navy"]
#>      navy 
#> "#285087"
